Today, Nolla Health became the first organization in the U.S. (and possibly the world) to receive regulatory approval for an AI to issue initial prescriptions.

This makes Nolla the first ever actual end-to-end AI doctor.

UTAH BECOMES FIRST STATE TO LET AI ISSUE PRESCRIPTIONS

Nolla Health is launching a Utah pilot where its AI can assess acne, review a patient’s medical history and send prescriptions directly to pharmacies without a doctor approving every prescription.

The program is limited to eight approved topical acne treatments, with no pills or hormone therapies.

Utah just let AI write a brand-new prescription. Until now, AI in Utah could only refill prescriptions a doctor had already written.

The company is Nolla Health. It starts with acne. A patient scans their face and answers 10 to 15 minutes of questions. The AI then prescribes an acne cream or gel, or sends the patient to a doctor if it is not sure.

posts.author: aus_mini
posts.text:
💥AI真的开始“看病开药”了？

美国初创公司 Nolla Health 宣布，其 AI 医疗系统已获犹他州监管试点批准，成为其所称的首个可由 AI 独立完成初次处方的医疗服务。

首个项目 Nolla Derm 针对18岁以上轻中度痤疮患者：用户通过 App 完成身份验证、问诊问卷和五角度面部扫描，约10–15分钟后，AI 可制定治疗方案，并在符合条件时开具外用药物处方。

但目前范围非常有限：
• 仅限轻中度痤疮
• 仅限外用药
• 不包括口服药、异维A酸和重度痤疮
• AI无法判断时必须转诊医生

前100名患者仍由两名执业医生在处方发出前独立审核，之后才逐步转向事后抽查。

而且每月只要5美金，你会试试吗？
